Our methods and metrics are built on the latest approaches in cognitive neuroscience, machine learning, and psychology.

Neurons’ solutions draw on decades of brain-scanning, eye-tracking and implicit research methods to model how people allocate attention, respond emotionally, process information, and memorize advertising.

Our models are trained and tested against the world's largest consumer neuroscience database (300,000+ people worldwide), so predictions reflect how audiences actually respond, not how a model assumes they will.

Our tools are designed to improve decision-making, enhance customer experiences, and foster positive relationships that benefit both organizations and their customers.
Neurons was founded in 2013 by neuroscientist and bestselling author, Dr. Thomas Zoëga Ramsøy, a leading figure in the fields of applied neuroscience, consumer neuroscience & neuromarketing.

Neurons is founded by Thomas Z. Ramsøy and Majken Z. Ramsøy, as a conversion from BrainWise. We build a strong industry-relevant consumer neuroscience database. From the start, we experiment with the prediction of behavior, including attention, emotion, stress, and more.
Thomas Z. Ramsøy, Majken Z. Ramsøy, and Mike Storm enter Neurons full-time as directors. The team grows steadily, with a primary focus on North America and Europe.
The first AI product and implicit online test service are launched. Neurons accelerates its growth journey with a successful pre-seed round with investments from Vækstfonden and Finance Zealand.
Establishing Our Values Program

We establish our values program, with a focus on ethics, responsible business, and scientific validity and integrity, in addition to company growth. To further our initiatives into ethical AI and responsible business, former Prime Minister of Denmark, Helle Thorning-Schmidt, joins the board.
We launch Neurons’ AI recommendations. Using machine learning technology, Neurons AI analyzes visual performance and gives recommendations for improving them.
The Best Neuromarketing Company

Neurons is continually recognized as the best neuromarketing company in the world. We’ve been awarded the Børsen Gazelle for 3 consecutive years for our steady growth and received the Best Global Consumer Neuroscience Company award in 2023.
